criteria.text: Source of calories and fatty acids for pediatric and adult patients with molecularly confirmed long-chain fatty acid oxidation disorders (LC-FAOD).

Molecularly confirmed LC-FAOD diagnosis based on at least TWO: (a) disease-specific elevations of acylcarnitines on a newborn blood spot or in plasma; (b) enzyme activity assay in cultured fibroblasts or lymphocytes below the reporting laboratory normal reference range; (c) genetic testing demonstrating a pathogenic mutation in a gene associated with LC-FAOD (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist or metabolic disease specialist (approval criterion 2).
Prescriber has submitted the patient's weight AND total prescribed daily caloric intake (approval criterion 3).
Dose does not exceed 35% of daily caloric intake (approval criterion 4).
Patient is not concurrently using another medium chain triglyceride product (denial criterion 2).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Dojolvi (triheptanoin) Criteria Version 1: Original 10/08/20; Approval 11/20/20; Effective 1/11/21.
Encoded: closed LC-FAOD indication, approval criteria 1-4 and denial criteria 1-2. Pediatric and adult patients are included; no numeric age gate is stated.

Molecular confirmation requires at least TWO of the three listed pathways. Any pair or all three qualifies under the PDF; genetic testing alone does not. Diagnostic evidence, weight and total prescribed daily caloric intake submission, and dose at or below 35% of daily caloric intake are attestations requiring manual review.
Cautions (notes only): avoid co-administration of Pancreatic Lipase Inhibitors due to potential for reduced clinical effect.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 12 months.

Quantity limit (notes only): 30 days; dose does not exceed 35% of the patient's caloric intake. The approval dose limit is encoded as an attestation; numeric dose calculation and quantity enforcement are not encoded.
Documentation verification, duration, quantity and cautions require manual review; this pack remains partial. No alternatives are specified.
